Complete the Phase 1 implant details below to proceed to Phase 2.'), patient/faculty/chief-complaint prefilled, augmentation-question-section ABSENT, payment/schedule empty; (7) My Cases: all 'Pre-Implant Augmentation: In Progress' cases (AUG-S3-A, AUG-S3-B, AUG-003, AUG-001) show P1 P2 P3 P4 all 'Locked' (bug fix confirmed); (8) brown 'Pre-Implant Augmentation ✓' badge visible on My Cases for AUG-UI-2 (Phase 1: Approved) and AUG-UI-1. None-exclusivity in complications verified: clicking None then Pain leaves only Pain selected. Failed-decision radios (terminate/repeat/proceed-phase2) all present.

None-exclusivity for complications: verified interactively — selecting 'None' then 'Pain' unchecks None. Implementation in step3 form correctly enforces this constraint (only 'Pain' remained in trigger summary after both clicks).
